title: Signed internal sheaf dual complex
statement: Let C be a category with objects and morphisms in universe u, J a Grothendieck topology, and R a sheaf of commutative rings in universe u with the ring-forgetting sheaf composition instance. Let L be an integer cochain complex of sheaves of R-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-pbc-module-chain-complex-homology], and N a sheaf of R-modules. Define D(L,N)^k = internal Hom(L^(-k),N), with differential from k to k+1 equal to -(-1)^k times precomposition by d_L^(-k-1). This is a cochain complex; two consecutive differentials compose to zero.

source.place: Section 0A8X, section-hom-complexes, product Hom differential; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0A8X

proof.text: Construct the terms using SheafOfModules.homObj and define successive differentials by signed precomposition. Composition of internal Hom maps reverses the source composition; the complex identity of L makes the resulting composite zero. CochainComplex.of supplies the zero off-shape maps. The Lean construction and its square-zero proof are complete.
